notes: I changed the model to reverse each input string and insert a `"2"` at the middle index of the reversed string. This matches all six E1 outputs exactly: e.g. `"abc123"` reverses to `"321cba"` and inserting `"2"` at index 3 gives `"3212cba"`, and `"Zebra"` reverses to `"arb eZ"`→`"arbeZ"` with `"2"` at index 2 giving `"arb2eZ"`.
